title: Clock-Free & Restart Invariance Audit
intuition: Audits whether a trainer is truly clock-free by perturbing four external schedule knobs — step label (+8192), total horizon (4096), evaluation cadence, and checkpoint restart — and asserting bit-exact state-hash parity plus zero hidden step-counter dependencies.
failure_mode: Hidden LR annealing, step-dependent noise schedules, lazy periodic counters, or uncheckpointed internal state break state-hash parity across perturbations.
protocol_notes: 24-step deterministic parity probe; parent specification of `clockfree_audit_measurement_v1`.
